physical.title: robe; coat
physical.summary: Man's heavy robe or coat (chapan) made of green and gold brocade with a silk and cotton satin ground woven with lobed roundels enclosing pink, yellow and orange stars. The cashew-shaped lobes inside the roundels are peach, blue, pink and purple. Lined in ikat silk and cotton with purple, green and pink donut-shaped patterns and yellow stripes. Also lined with a triangular patch of red floral printed cotton and a patch of striped and chequered cotton under the right arm. Finished on the external edges and sleeve-cuffs with needle-braided edging in green, white, pink and blue cotton.
